background: ICBC (London) plc is the UK-incorporated subsidiary of Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, the world's largest bank by assets and majority-owned by the Chinese state, serving Chinese corporates and trade and treasury business in London.
synthesis: None of the three main agencies rates the London subsidiary, so the case rests on its figures and on its parent. Capital is exceptionally high, with CET1 of 81.1% and leverage of 47.5% in the top quarter of UK small banks, and both have risen since 31 Mar 2024, by 24.5 and 14.8 points. LCR of 144% is in the bottom quarter, though NSFR of 173% is above the median. The figures run only to 31 Dec 2025.
